brief: Clear the site storage placed against the ventilation opening on the east side, top up the conservator level which is low, investigate the light oil film on the bund floor consistent with a slow leak, and complete the previously raised gasket repair. Where the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021].
